body:
Mimih Dreambinder
CR 6

An impossibly thin figure emerges from a hairline crack in the wall, its large red eyes glowing as ethereal wisps of energy dance around its elongated form.

XP 2,400
Mimih Dreambinder 7
N Medium fey (extraplanar)
Init +9; +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +3 Wis)
hp 35 (7d6+7)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +8; DR 5/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 15 ft.
Space 5 ft.; can compress to move through spaces 1/4 normal size
Melee quarterstaff +3 (1d6-2)
Special Attacks dream surge
Dreambinder Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +10)

0th (3/day)—detect magic, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
1st (4/day)—color spray, sleep (DC 14), silent image (DC 15)
2nd (3/day)—invisibility, minor image (DC 16)
3rd (2/day)—major image (DC 17), displacement

Psionic Powers Known (ML 7th; 26 PP; concentration +10)

1st—inertial armor, mind thrust (DC 14)
2nd—cloud mind (DC 15), thought shield
3rd—energy bolt, time hop

TACTICS

Before Combat The dreambinder prefers to observe from hiding, using their dream wisp companion to scout ahead.

During Combat In combat, they first activate Dreamweaving and use Reality Anchor to disrupt enemy illusions. They focus on control spells and powers, using their Dream Surge ability to increase save DCs.

Morale If threatened, they’ll use their compression ability to escape through tiny spaces, leaving their dream wisp to distract pursuers.

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 18, Wis 16, Cha 13
Base Atk +3; CMB +1, CMD 13
Feats Dream Reservoir, Reality Anchor, Spell Focus (Illusion)
Skills Knowledge (arcana) +14, Knowledge (planes) +14, Perception +13, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +12
Languages Common, Mimih, Sylvan, Draconic
SQ dreamweaving (7 minutes/day), dream wisp, lucid dreaming

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dream Surge (Su)

When casting a spell or manifesting a power, the dreambinder can expend psionic focus while using Dreamweaving to add +2 to the DC and +2 to overcome spell/power resistance.

Dream Wisp Companion

The dreambinder has a Tiny outsider companion that grants +2 on saves vs. illusions and sleep effects when within reach.

The dreambinder companion can deliver touch spells/powers.

ECOLOGY

Environment any arid
Organization solitary, pair, or enclave (3–8)
Treasure Standard
